MEX.name: Mexico
MEX.notes: Co-host. Won 2025 Nations League + Gold Cup.

KOR.name: South Korea
KOR.notes: Only unbeaten AFC qualifier. Poor pre-tournament form. Lost 0-5 Brazil, 0-1 Austria, 0-4 Ivory Coast. Wins only vs minnows.

CZE.name: Czechia
CZE.notes: Qualified via penalties vs Ireland and Denmark.

RSA.name: South Africa
RSA.notes: First WC since 2010. Lost all 3 pre-tournament friendlies.

CAN.name: Canada
CAN.notes: Co-host. No qualifying pressure. Davies out G1. David-dependent attack. Copa 2024 scored 2 in 5.

SUI.name: Switzerland
SUI.notes: Consistently solid Europeans. Dangerous in group stage.

QAT.name: Qatar
QAT.notes: Defending host, weak exit in 2022. Improved since.

BIH.name: Bosnia & Herzegovina
BIH.notes: First ever World Cup appearance. Qualified via penalties (Wales, Italy). Dzeko 40 at Schalke. Drew Panama 1-1, N.Macedonia 0-0.

BRA.name: Brazil
BRA.notes: 5x champions. Hunting to end long title drought.

MAR.name: Morocco
MAR.notes: 2022 semifinalists. AFCON 2025 champions but not convincing. Ezzalzouli knee (2-3wks), Mazraoui shoulder uncertain. Drew Norway 1-1.

SCO.name: Scotland
SCO.notes: First WC since 1998. Strong qualification run.

USA.name: United States
USA.notes: Co-host. Lost Belgium 2-5, Portugal 0-2, Germany 1-2. Beat Senegal 3-2, Uruguay 5-1. Pochettino still building. Adams/Wright injured.

AUS.name: Australia
AUS.notes: 2022 QF. Beat Japan 1-0, Saudi Arabia 2-1 in qualifying. McGree (key CM) out torn hamstring. Lost 0-1 Mexico, drew 1-1 Switzerland June 2026.

TUR.name: Turkey
TUR.notes: EURO 2024 QF. Guler (21, Real Madrid) + Yildiz (20, Juventus). Montella 3yr continuity. NL A promotion.

GER.name: Germany
GER.notes: EURO 2024 QF hosts. Hunger to end major trophy drought.

ECU.name: Ecuador
ECU.notes: Consistent CONMEBOL qualifiers. Good team structure.

CIV.name: Ivory Coast
CIV.notes: AFCON 2023 champions. Beat France 2-1 friendly. Unbeaten qualifying, 0 goals conceded. Lost AFCON 2025 title in QF.

CUW.name: Curacao
CUW.notes: Surprise CONCACAF qualifier. Significant step up in class.

NED.name: Netherlands
NED.notes: EURO 2024 SF. Xavi Simons ACL out. De Ligt/de Vrij/Schouten also out. Beat Norway 2-1, drew Ecuador 1-1, lost 0-1 Algeria.

JPN.name: Japan
JPN.notes: Beat England at Wembley + Brazil 3-2. Mitoma + Minamino both out injured. Core 25-29 intact.

SWE.name: Sweden
SWE.notes: Qualified comfortably. Isak leads the line. Solid unit.

BEL.name: Belgium
BEL.notes: Golden generation fading but De Bruyne still world class.

IRN.name: Iran
IRN.notes: Defensively sound AFC qualifier. Difficult to beat.

EGY.name: Egypt
EGY.notes: Salah's last tournament chance. Must support him with quality.

NZL.name: New Zealand
NZL.notes: OFC qualifiers. Massive step up in class at WC level.

ESP.name: Spain
ESP.notes: EURO 2024 champions. Yamal era in full swing.

URU.name: Uruguay
URU.notes: Tough, experienced. Darwin Nunez leads attack.

KSA.name: Saudi Arabia
KSA.notes: 2022 giant killers. Established in top Asian bracket.

CPV.name: Cape Verde
CPV.notes: AFCON regulars. Compact defensively, pace in transition.

FRA.name: France
FRA.notes: 5 PSG CL winners in squad. Dembele Ballon d'Or, Doue CL Young Player. Saliba doubtful (back). Lost 1-2 to Ivory Coast (their R32 opponent).

SEN.name: Senegal
SEN.notes: AFCON champions. Mane-generation core still competitive.

NOR.name: Norway
NOR.notes: Haaland-powered. First WC since 1998. High goal threat.

IRQ.name: Iraq
IRQ.notes: Improved AFC side. First WC since 1986.

ARG.name: Argentina
ARG.notes: Reigning world champions. Messi's farewell tournament.

AUT.name: Austria
AUT.notes: EURO 2024 RO16. Alaba era ending, new generation solid.

ALG.name: Algeria
ALG.notes: Experienced CAF qualifier. First WC since 2014. Beat Netherlands 1-0.

JOR.name: Jordan
JOR.notes: AFC playoff qualifier. AFCON runners-up 2023. Surprise package.

POR.name: Portugal
POR.notes: Nations League 2025 winners vs Spain. Joao Neves 21, Vitinha 26 prime midfield. Martinez 3yr continuity.

COL.name: Colombia
COL.notes: Copa America 2024 runners-up. Beat Brazil + Argentina in qualifying. Diaz at Bayern peak. 4231 limits attack routes vs low-block; Stanišić knows Díaz well. Lost 1-2 vs Croatia, 1-3 vs France in June 2026 friendlies.

UZB.name: Uzbekistan
UZB.notes: Beat Netherlands 5-3 pre-WC. Khusanov (Man City) elite. Fayzullaev 22 ascending. Cannavaro coach (Oct 2025). Lost to Canada 0-2.

COD.name: DR Congo
COD.notes: First WC since 1974. Wissa (Newcastle) elite. Lost 6-2 Chile friendly. Defensive fragility exposed.

GHA.name: Ghana
GHA.notes: Queiroz coach (Apr 2026, 8wks before tournament). Kudus out (surgery). Missed AFCON 2025. Semenyo/Williams talent floor.

PAN.name: Panama
PAN.notes: 2x CONCACAF finalist (2023, 2025). Unbeaten qualifying. Christiansen 6yr. Carrasquilla groin concern.
